sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM longest_absense_from_school AS T1 INNER JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.month >= 5

SELECT T1.name, T1.school FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.organ = 'air_force'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM male AS T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'neg'

SELECT COUNT(name) FROM person

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.name IN (SELECT name FROM unemployed) THEN 'unemployed' ELSE 'employed' END, CASE WHEN T1.name IN (SELECT name FROM disabled) THEN 'disabled' ELSE 'not disabled' END, CASE WHEN T1.name IN (SELECT name FROM male) THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END, T2.bool FROM person AS T1 LEFT JOIN no_payment_due AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.name IN ('student180', 'student117')
SELECT T2.organ, T1.school FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.name IN ('student27', 'student17', 'student101')
